evidence.name: 10th Annual Report on Environmental Strategy, Cluster A (period July 2025 - July 2026), version 01.00, 40 pages
evidence.provider: Fraport Regional Airports of Greece A S.A.

page_38_table_10_verified_CO2e_2025_tonn.columns: Scope 1 direct | Scope 2 indirect | Total (location based)

findings.page_37_targets: Scope 1+2 CO2eq: -42.0 % by 2030, -80.7 % by 2040, net zero by 2045; base year 2018; FGA+FGB+FGM.
findings.page_38_accreditation: ACA Level 1 (footprint measurement) renewed for 6 airports; Level 2 for SKG.
findings.page_30_air_quality: Permanent air quality monitoring station at CFU (and SKG); mobile-station campaigns at EFL, ZTH, PVK (and CHQ, KVA); dispersion modelling per Environmental Terms. Results published in annual Environmental Bulletins per airport.
findings.scope_note: Scope 1 and 2 only: airport-operator fuel, generators, refrigerants and purchased electricity. Aircraft (LTO) emissions are not included.

evidence.name: Environmental Bulletin of Kerkira Airport (CFU) - 2024, R2, 19 pages
evidence.provider: Fraport Regional Airports of Greece A S.A.

findings.page_7_monitoring: One measurement point, 39°36'44.9"N 19°54'28.4"E, KTEO parking lot ~500 m east of the airport; period 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31; pollutants PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, C6H6, O3. CO2 is not measured. Summary only (PM10 exceedances attributed to an asphalt plant outside the airport); no numeric series in the bulletin.
findings.page_8_modelling: AEDT + AERMOD dispersion modelling; contours for PM10, PM2.5, NOx, SOx, C6H6, CO (a CO2 contour figure is shown); no exceedances.

observations: RISK: In Table 10 only the Total column is labelled '(Location based)'; the Scope 2 column header is 'Indirect emissions Scope 2', so reading it as location-based is inferred (Total - Scope 1 = 1,931.9 - 94.9 = 1,837.0). CFU 2025 Scope 2 (1,837.0 t) is 0.4 % from the 2024 market-based figure (1,828.9 t, bulletin) and 27 % below the 2024 location-based one (2,503.6 t). Either a real fall or a basis mix-up; unresolved. Do not use CFU 2025 Scope 2 until Fraport clarifies the basis.
Earlier bulletins exist per airport for 2018-2024 (EFL 2024 only in the Greek folder), so an annual 2018-2025 series is plausibly assemblable; not pulled.
status: VERIFIED (access and content). Use in Data01 is a PROPOSAL needing a DECISION (redefinition from concentration to operator emissions) and Codewhale review; reuse requires Fraport's written consent.
